scripts.dev:fresh: bun run db:reset && bun run --filter @nylon-impossible/web --filter @nylon-impossible/api dev
scripts.test: bun run web:test && bun run api:test
scripts.lint: bun run tokens:check && bun run web:lint && bun run api:lint && bun run admin:lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run web:lint:fix && bun run api:lint:fix && bun run admin:lint:fix
scripts.format: bun run web:format && bun run api:format && bun run admin:format
scripts.check: bun run tokens:check && bun run web:check && bun run api:check && bun run admin:check
scripts.check:fix: bun run web:check:fix && bun run api:check:fix && bun run admin:check:fix
scripts.typecheck: bun run web:typecheck && bun run api:typecheck && bun run admin:typecheck
scripts.deploy: bun run api:deploy && bun run web:deploy
scripts.db:migrate: CI=true wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c src/api/wrangler.jsonc && CI=true wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c src/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c src/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c src/api/wrangler.jsonc --file=src/api/src/db/seeds/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c src/web/wrangler.jsonc --file=src/api/src/db/seeds/seed.sql
scripts.db:status: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c src/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -project 'src/ios/Nylon Impossible/Nylon Impossible.xcodeproj' -scheme 'Nylon Impossible' -configuration Debug build
